item.psychoroulette.miracle_pill.desc: Grants 60 seconds of pure peace and clears all disorders.
item.psychoroulette.reroll_token.desc: Instantly rerolls your current Psycho-Roulette diagnosis.
psychoroulette.hud.title: PSYCHO-ROULETTE
disorder.psychoroulette.pyromania.name: Pyromania
disorder.psychoroulette.pyromania.desc: Stay near fire or burn things, or suffer withdrawal!
disorder.psychoroulette.megalomania.name: Megalomania
disorder.psychoroulette.megalomania.desc: You are a god: huge damage, but no shields, cheap food, or fleeing.
disorder.psychoroulette.kleptomania.name: Kleptomania
disorder.psychoroulette.kleptomania.desc: Your hands automatically steal from nearby chests and villagers.
disorder.psychoroulette.tourette.name: Tourette's Syndrome
disorder.psychoroulette.tourette.desc: Random tics: dropping items, jumping, and aggroing mobs.
disorder.psychoroulette.narcolepsy.name: Narcolepsy
disorder.psychoroulette.narcolepsy.desc: You randomly pass out at the worst possible moments.
disorder.psychoroulette.agoraphobia.name: Agoraphobia
disorder.psychoroulette.agoraphobia.desc: Open sky causes panic. Get under a roof!
disorder.psychoroulette.claustrophobia.d: Low ceilings and tight walls suffocate you.
disorder.psychoroulette.hallucinations.d: Fake creepers, phantom footsteps, and cursed chat messages.
disorder.psychoroulette.sociophobia.name: Sociophobia
disorder.psychoroulette.sociophobia.desc: Any living creature nearby triggers a panic attack.
disorder.psychoroulette.acrophobia.name: Acrophobia
disorder.psychoroulette.acrophobia.desc: Severe fear of ledges and drops — vertigo hits hard.
disorder.psychoroulette.hydrophobia.name: Hydrophobia
disorder.psychoroulette.hydrophobia.desc: Water and rain burn you like an Enderman.
disorder.psychoroulette.nyctophobia.name: Nyctophobia
disorder.psychoroulette.nyctophobia.desc: Darkness hurts you. Stay near torches or sunlight!
disorder.psychoroulette.ocd.name: Severe OCD
disorder.psychoroulette.ocd.desc: Complete compulsive rituals and keep your inventory neat.
disorder.psychoroulette.bipolar.name: Bipolar Disorder
disorder.psychoroulette.paranoia.name: Paranoia
disorder.psychoroulette.paranoia.desc: Keep looking behind you or terror will overwhelm you.
disorder.psychoroulette.hyperphagia.name: Hyperphagia
disorder.psychoroulette.hyperphagia.desc: Extreme hunger drain, but eating grants bursts of power.
disorder.psychoroulette.hoarding.name: Hoarding Disorder
disorder.psychoroulette.hoarding.desc: More clutter = more power. Dropping items hurts!
disorder.psychoroulette.amnesia.name: Amnesia
disorder.psychoroulette.amnesia.desc: You forget what you're holding and where you're going.
disorder.psychoroulette.dromomania.name: Dromomania
disorder.psychoroulette.dromomania.desc: Never stop moving for more than 2 seconds. Keep running!
disorder.psychoroulette.berserk_psychosi: Hit mobs for huge buffs. Peace causes withdrawal!
